assetInfoList.assetInfo:
Press the <color=blue>{4} key to perform a standard attack, dealing damage to enemies directly ahead.

Press the <color=blue>{6} key to dodge,
it will carry out an additional attack toward the nearest enemy.
Hold direction keys <color=blue>{0}/{1} to adjust the dodge direction.

Ilia's <color=blue>standard attacks and <color=blue>dodge attacks charge her alchemy gauge.

<color=red>When the combo count reaches 30, the charge speed greatly increases!
Use dodge attacks can quickly build combos!

When alchemy gauge has one or more charges,
 using skill2 grants her an alchemic cartridge for each charge of the alchemy gauge.

After Alchemic Cartridges are loaded, Ilia's skills 1-3 become more powerful, dealing more damage.
Each skill used consumes one Alchemic Cartridge and boosts her critical rate!

Use Alchemic Cartridges for high damage in a short period!

Ilia's skill "Otherworld Gate" leaves a portal after attacking.
Press <color=blue>{11} to teleport to the portal.

Only one portal can exist on the field, useful for dodging unavoidable attacks!

Dagger units have fast attacks but short range.
Press <color=blue>{4} to perform a standard attack.
The first standard attack of the dagger quickly approaches the target!

Ezelith deals extra damage to enemies with reduced defense or in break state!

Press <color=blue>{8} to use "Brilliant Inferno" and grant the Inferno Mode buff.
During the buff, standard attacks can reduce enemy defense!

Ezelith's skill "Howling Meteor" increases critical rate upon hitting enemies twice!

Additionally, during or after "Howling Meteor", using "Dazzling Star" immediately interrupts the skill and deals higher damage!

Hold direction keys <color=blue>{0}/{1} before using "Dazzling Star" to adjust the dash direction!
This skill can dodge enemy attacks flexibly!

Renelle is a easy-to-play dagger unit,
dealing high damage to burnt enemies.

Both skill 1 and skill 2 inflict burn state on enemies!
When the combo count is 15 or higher, skill 2 can dispel one enemy buff!
Using skill 3 significantly increases her strength in the remainder of the quest!
When the effect reaches its limit, also grants the burn punisher buff!

Zena is a staff unit with powerful healing and survival abilities!

Press <color=blue>{4} to use a standard attack that follows enemies within a certain range.

The auspex gauge next to the status bar charges each time a skill is used.
<color=red>After 3 charges, Zena gains a powerful Twilight Moon buff.

While Twilight Moon is active, hold <color=blue>{4} to charge a special force strike.
Movement is possible while charging but slows down.
At full charge (5 stages), it deals very high damage to enemies in range!

Using skill 2 "Holy Crown" grants the <color=red>Holy Faith buff,
which increases charging speed and damage, <color=red>while granting knockback immunity and reducing damage taken!
It's better to charge while [Holy Faith] is active!
Press <color=blue>{7} to use "Glorious Sanctuary" to restore a lot of HP and leave a healing zone.

Touching the healing zone again after leaving
restores HP once more!

The healing zone is marked on the mini-map with a special icon!

Press <color=blue>{9} to use "Twilight Crown" to deal continuous damage to surronding enemies.
Every 10 hits grant an additional HP recovery buff!

When HP recovery buff reaches 3 stacks, press <color=blue>{10} to use "Celestial Prayer" to deal higher damage and <color=red>charge the auspex gauge an extra time!

Quickly fill the auspex gauge to use the powerful Twilight Moon attack!

Sheila is a dagger unit with a unique standard attack combo. Pressing the <color=blue>{4} key to perform rapid standard attacks.

On the 7th standard attack combo, Sheila gains the <color=red>Blazewolf’s Rush buff.

Sheila's 6th combo sprint forward quickly, then return to the initial position on the 7th combo.

Dodging during the 7th hit sequence prevents her return,
useful for dodgding enemy attacks.

Dodging during a standard attack will deal damage to surrounding enemies. Performing a standard attack during this unique dodge will then resume the user's standard attack combo from their most recent attack.

Pressing <color=blue>{3} mid-air accelerates her falling speed.

Sheila can use skills alternatively for high damage!
"Carmine Rush" skill inflicts Evil’s Bane, "Flame Raid" deals critical hits on enemies with Evil's Bane.

For the duration of these skills, Sheila will be immune to knockback and take less damage.

Using "Carmine Rush"swaps the next skill 2 becomes "Savage Flame Raid" 
Using "Flame Raid" swaps the next skill 1 to "Bright Carmine Rush" increasing damage.

If Blazewolf's Rush is active, enhanced Skills 1/2 consume the buff and charge the opposite skill gauge! Triggering both skills rapidly is possible when they are ready.

Sheila's Skill3 leaves a phantom.
When she uses Skill 1 or Skill 2, it will perform the same attack then disappear.

Blazing Blitz skill can be upgraded after clearing certain quest.
When use the upgraded skill, Sheila increases her critical rate or critical damage for several seconds.

Zethia has a special standard attack combo. Press <color=blue>{6} to perform a unique dodge attack.
Performing a standard attack during this dodge will then resume the user's standard attack combo from their most recent attack.
Besides, Zehita can deal damage to enemies when she dodges their attacks.

Hold <color=blue>{4} to charge up the force strike. During the charge, use the directional keys <color=blue>{0}/{1} to adjust the attack direction and deal damage to enemies in a line in the attack direction.

Press <color=blue>{8} to activate "Blessing of Creation," granting oneself a high special critical damage buff and immunity to control afflictions. During the buff, dodge attacks can inflict a special defense reduction debuff, which grants Zethia's standard attacks can deal critical damage to them.
Press <color=blue>{7} to use "Genesis Circlet" to damage surrounding enemies. However, its skill gauge can only be charged with time. Time the skill release wisely!

Zethia has a special summon gauge on the left side of her status bar. When the guage is lit. Press <color=blue>{11} to consume the summon gauge to summon Bahamut, dealing massive damage to enemies directly ahead. Additionally, grants the "Almighty Rage" buff, increases her strength and defense for a period.
The summon gauge can be filled by dealing damage to enemies. Furthermore, when Zethia's 3rd, 5th, 7th, 8th, and 9th stage standard attacks hit, they also charge the Summon Gauge.
Wand units are proficient in using skills to deal damage. The standard attack speed of a wand is relatively slow but can follow enemies within a certain range.

Origa is a special wand unit with a special dragondrive gauge. When the gauge is lit, press <color=blue>{11} to activate dragondrive, significantly enhancing skills.

At the start of a quest, Origa gains a Demon Seal debuff, during which the dragondrive gauge cannot charge. Using skill 2 "Banish Evil" will immediately remove this debuff and grant the Seal Released buff. <color=red>Quickly fill skill 2's skill gauge to get the "Seal Released" buff!

When Seal Released, the dragondrive gauge charges rapidly, and all affliction resistance is increased by 100%. During dragondrive, Orliga's standard attacks become more powerful. Press <color=blue>{11} to exit Dragondrive mode.

When dragondrive, skill 1 Cocytus Whirl can deal damage surronding enemies within a large area, <color=blue>and inflict bog, frostbite, and freeze afflictions. Bogged targets' move slower and take more damage. Skill 2 "Banish Evil" can deal damage to enemies directly ahead, <color=blue>inflicting Nihility. which can dispel most of the enemy's buffs and prevent them from granting buffs.

Cleo is a special wand character that balances survival and damage.
Press <color=blue>{7} to use Ancient Ray, dealing damage to multiple targets on the field.
Press <color=blue>{8} to apply a debuff to the target with Faith of the Elders skill.

After each use of "Ancient Ray," Cleo gains the "Altered Strike" buff.
During its effect, hold <color=blue>{4} to charge a special force strike. Upon release, a strength buff area will be generated. (Using the directional keys <color=blue>{0}/{1} to adjust the position of the buff area.)
<color=red>Using skills 3 and 4 within the "Altered Strike" buff area will grant additional powerful effects.

<color=red>Cleo can deal an additional 35% damage to enemies with reduced strength!
If enemies with reduced strength damage Cleo, they will also receive reflection damage based on Cleo's strength and reduce their defense!

Use skill 3 Ancient Aegis and skill 2 Faith of the Elders to reduce enemy attack!

Notte has a unique standard attack combo.

 She's less affected by gravity when she dodges in the air.

Notte has a metamorphosis gauge on the left side of her status bar.
When it lits up, press <color=blue> {11} </color> to enter metamorphosis.

Notte's skills in human form can <color=red>dispel one enemy buff.
</color>
Her skill 1 can be performed in the air to chase moving enemies.
Her skill 2 can draw enemies together. 

When her combo count is 15 or higher, the metamorphosis gauge will charge when skill connects enemy.
So try to keep your combo count!

Notte attack slowly in metamorphosis, but the damage and knockback chance increase a lot.

Hold direction keys<color=blue>{2}/{0}/{3}/{1}</color> to move in four directions.

After completing 3 quests, Notte's skill Emergency Treatment will change to Faerie Sunrise, which grant the user Faerie Sunrise buff for 40 seconds,<color=red>allowing skills used during Metamorphosis to restore Notte's HP!

Sword units has a flexible force strike. Hold<color=blue> {4} </color>to charge.
The user cannot move while charging, but can use direction keys<color=blue>{0}/{1}</color>to change their attack direction.
When holding direction keys <color=blue>{0}/{1}</color> during the attack, the user can move through the enemies.

Alex has a special skill mechanism and standard attack combo.
Skills 1 and 2 consume one special skill gauge, which is displayed on the left side of the character's status bar. (Max:3)

The skill gauge does not charge over time.

Alex's skills 1 and 2 trigger a skill chain, adding extra effects.

During the Skill Chain, using <color=red>the same skill as last time will deal additional damage to the target.  <color=blue>
The skill icon that can trigger the Skill Chain effect will flash!

When enemies have buffs that can be dispelled or are in break state, Alex's skill chain can cause additional effects.
If the target has a buff, <color=red>alternating skills </color> can dispel one buff.
If the target is in break state, <color=red>alternating skills</color> can deal more damage.

Alex deals higher damage to poisoned enemies or enemies with reduced defense!

Also, Alex's strength will increase after inflicting the defense reduction or poison!

Blade units have a special force strike that can sprint forward and deal damage in a line. Hold<color=blue> {4} </color>to charge. The user cannot move while charging, but can use direction keys<color=blue>{0}/{1}</color>to change their attack direction. Also, hold direction keys <color=blue>{0}/{1}</color> during performing the 5th standard attack combo can change the attack direction too.

Bleeding is a<color=red> debuff </color>that causes damage over time.
This effect stacks up to 3 times, dealing damage every 5 seconds.
Its damage also increases with the stack of damage and possible to cause critical damage.

Ieyasu's skill 1 can inflict Bleeding on enemies.
Skill 2 increases the critical rate against bleeding enemies.
Skill 3 deals additional damage based on the enemies' bleeding effect.

Bow unit's attack deals damage to enemies in a line. Their dash attack in the air changes to a ranged attack targeting the closest enemy.

Hold <color=blue>{4}</color> to charge a force strike.
While charging, movement is possible but speed is reduced.

Life Shield is special shield that acts more like a second HP bar.
When active, its value will display as an orange bar above the adventurer's HP bar.
If more damage is taken than the Life Shield can withstand, the Life Shield will nullify as much damage as it can before the adventurer takes damage.

<color=red>Life Shield cannot block damage-over-time effects.

Louise deals higher damage to poisoned targets!
Skill 1 can inflict poison and restore her HP.
The damage of skill 2 decreases as the player's current HP percentage decreases.

<color=red>Try to keep high HP to significantly increase damage!

Press <color=blue>{10}</color> to use skill 3, granting Louise various buffs and a Life Shield.
During the buff's duration, her force strike reduces the target's poison resistance.
When enemies have high poison resistance, this effect can significantly increase the probability of skill 1 inflicting poison!

Energy is a special buff which upgrades certain skills once five energy levels have been accumulated.
Once five energy levels have been accumulated, an adventurer becomes "Energized", and their next attack skill / recovery skill will be upgraded to have more damage / potency.

If adventurer has afflictions, energy will be nullified.

Inspriation is a special buff which upgrades certain skills once five inspiration levels have been accumulated.
Once five inspriation levels have been accumulated, an adventurer becomes "Inspired", and their next attack skill will have 100% critical hit rate on all of the skill's hits.

If adventurer has afflictions, inspiration will be nullified.

Pinon is an apostle with a special sigil mechanism.
At the start of a quest, she receives a 120-second Locked Sigil debuff.
After the Locked Sigil is released, Pinon gains the Sigil Released buff, significantly enhancing her performance.

Pinon's skill 1 inflicts frostbite on targets in a line.
Skill 2 grants her the Gabriel's Blessing buff. This buff greatly increases her strength for 40 seconds, but it is removed upon taking damage.
Skill 3 can freeze surrounding enemies and create a special zone. <color=red>While in this zone, Gabriel’s Blessing will not be removed when attacked by enemies.

Pinon has a special force strike that can charge up to two levels.
Hold the<color=blue>{4} </color>to charge.
When fully charged, it can <color=red>reduce the Locked Sigil time</color> and deal an additional 200% damage to frostbitten enemies.

Use this ability to quickly release the Locked Sigil!

After sigil released, Pinon's dash attack performing in air can <color=red>dispel one enemy buff</color>.
Additionally, her standard attacks add an extra 6th combo.
Press <color=blue>{4} </color> to release this special combo, dealing high damage to enemies in a line, recovering HP, and possibly raise one energy level.
During the attack, Pinon is immune to knockback, and her attack direction can be adjusted by pressing direction keys <color=blue>{0}/{1}</color>.

After the Locked Sigil is released, Pinon’s skill 3 deals extra damage to frostbitten enemies.

<color=red>After using skill 1, immediately perform standard attacks can start from the 5th combo. Take advantage of this feature to quickly start the special 6th combo!

Bondforged Zethia has special standard attaacks.<color=blue>She has powerful recovery abilities.</color>

She will restore HP automatically when HP is below 30%.
(This ability has a cooldown time.)

Zethia's Skill 2 can grant <color=red>Power of Bonds</color> buff.
Zethia deals more skill damage when this buff is active.
Also, when receiving lethal damage, this buff will protect her from the damage and restore HP.
The recovery potency will decrease every time this effect is triggered.

Zethia's Skill 1 deals damage to target directly ahead, when Power of Bonds is active, this attack can dispel one buff.

Zethia's Skill 3 deals damage surronding her, inflicting stun to enemies that face her.
If target is close to her, this skill will be more likely to deal critical damage.

Zethia's Skill 4 can increase her max HP and strength.

When the HP buff reaches 30%, this skill can even increase her critical rate.

Fleur's skills can inflict paralysis and various debuff to enemies.

Paralyzed or debuffed foes will take more damage for her.

Fleur's skill 2 activates her skill 1, grants a special strength buff and raises her inspiration level.

If this buff is active, her skill 3 can inflict an addition debuff!

Lance units' standard attack is slow but have longer range.
They can perform a force strike that deal damage to enemies directly ahead.
Hold<color=blue> {4} </color>to charge a force strike.
The user cannot move while charging, but can use direction keys<color=blue>{0}/{1}</color>to change their attack direction.

Halloween Elisanne's skill have many additional buff effects.
Her skill 1 at Phase II can also restore HP.

Her skill 2 grants Vampire Maiden buff, which make the skill gauges fill more quickly.
Staff units' standard attack rate is slow, but they have powerful recovery skills.

In addition, Elisanne's skill 4 can restore HP and relief a debuff.

If her HP is below 50%, this skill will recharge for 35%. Otherwise, she will grant immunity to DoT affliction once!

Some skills will trigger a "Skill Shift" under certain conditions.
After a "Skill Shift," the effect of using the skill will change for the next use.
When the "Skill Shift" reaches its highest phase, the next "Skill Shift" will instead remove the "Skill Shift" status, so that the next use of the skill will return to its initial phase.

Regina is an apostle with a special sigil mechanism, deals more damage to afflicted enemies.
At the start of a quest, she receives a 120-second Locked Sigil debuff.
After the Locked Sigil is removed, Regina gains the Sigil Released buff, adds additional effects when using skills.

Regina gains Preservation Protocol at the start of a quest.
Hold <color=blue> {4} </color>to charge force strike,the effect will cycle through the Preservation Protocol, Restoration Protocol, and Purification Protocol in that order.

When using skill 1 and skill 4, the skill will grant extra effects according to buff she has.

Regina's skill 1 reduces Locked Sigil's remaining time.
When <color=blue>Preservation Protocol </color>/<color=#007700> Restoration Protocol </color>/<color=purple> Purification Protocol</color> is active, she will <color=blue>increase defense</color> /<color=#007700> restore HP</color> / <color=purple>relief an affliction</color>.

Regina's skill 4 heals her over time.
When <color=blue>Preservation Protocol </color>/<color=#007700> Restoration Protocol </color>/<color=purple> Purification Protocol</color> is active, she will <color=blue>immune to knockback</color> /<color=#007700> restore HP</color> / <color=purple>relief a debuff</color>.

Regina's skill 3 adds a special mark to nearest enemy directly ahead.
Use skill 3 again to activate the mark, dealing massive damage to the target.
When target's <color=red> counter </color> mark is lit up, this skill will deal critical damage.

<color=red>The mark can be activated while player is attacking, dodging or moving!

Additionally, Regina deals more damage to afflicted targets.

Use skill 2 to inflict multiple afflictions!
After sigil released, Regina gain all Preservation/Restoration/Purification Protocol, making her skill 1 and skill 4 can gain all additional effects.

Summer Elisanne increases defense every time she uses skills.

With skill damage doublebuff ability, she can apply multiple buffs when use skills.

Elisanne's skill 3 raises energy level by three.
And her skill 1 inflicts bog and shadowblight.

(Bogged enemies move slower and take more damage.)

Elisanne's skill 2 deals extra damage based on how many buffs she has.

If she is energized, this skill's critical rate and OD gauge decrease will be increased siginificantly.

<color=red>It's better to use energized effect on this skill!</color>
Axe units have a slow standard attack combo, but their resistance to knockback and defense are higher.

Althemia deals much more skill damage when HP is full.

Use recovery skills to keep full HP!

Althemia have various skills to heal herself.

Her skill 3 deals damage to surronding enemies and restores HP.
Her skill 4 restores HP and reliefs a DoT affliction.
In addition, her skill 2 grants Life Shield which can protect her from direct damage.

Curran has a powerful last offense ability.
When his HP is below 50%, strength and defense will increase sharply.

Try to take enemies' damage and trigger the last offense ability!

Curran's skill 1 and skill 2 deals extra damage to poisoned foes.
His skill 3 allows his force strike inflicting poison to enemies.

Use skill 3 and inflict poison to enemies before using attack skills!
Heinwald's skill damage increases when HP is above 70%, and he will consume HP and fill skill gauge when use skills.

Although he will consume HP when use skills, his skill 1 and skill 4 can restore his HP.

And his skill 3 deals extra damage based on total HP he lost.
His skill 2 can also enhance the skill effects!

Lathna's skill 2 deals a lot damage.
When she has Faceless Moon buff, she deals even more damage.

Use skill 3 to keep Faceless Moon buff active is very important!

Lathna's skill 3 can only be filled from skill 1 attack connects.
When Faceless Moon reaches Lv3, its duration will longer than when it's below Lv3!

Try to use skill 1 often to raise the Faceless Moon level as soon as possible!

格蕾丝主要依靠技能1提供的<color=red>【慧剑封印】</color>大幅提升伤害。
当其达到4层时，攻击威力会提高80%，但攻击时会损失HP。

格蕾丝没有直接回复HP的技能，但拥有的【防御链·治愈】能力
使得自身每次获得<color=blue>防御增益</color>时能够持续回复HP。

此外，技能4能够消耗HP并将其转化为生命护盾。

格蕾丝的技能能够快速叠加防御增益来触发【防御链·治愈】。
技能2会使自身进入“劫火”异常状态，但会提升2次防御力，
期间受到伤害时会使敌人也陷入“劫火”状态。

技能3会消耗所有【慧剑封印】，并根据消耗的层数造成伤害和提升防御力。
释放此技能时HP越少，造成的伤害也越高。
在HP不足或是需要短时间内输出时，使用此技能很有用！

菲约尔姆主要通过SP需求较低的技能1给敌人造成伤害，
令目标进入“冻伤”和“冰冻”状态。
(成功施加冻伤状态时，菲约尔姆能提升攻击力和暴击率。)

且技能3也能提供增加技能槽积攒速率的增益，
增益存在时，技能1能够追加使敌人冻伤抗性下降的效果。
<color=red>尽量保持技能3增益的覆盖率吧！</color>

菲约尔姆的技能2“冰之圣镜”有特殊的反击机制。

使用技能时，菲约尔姆会进入短暂的反击待命状态，
并在短时间内受到远程攻击的伤害降低。
若此时<color=red>立刻承受敌人攻击</color>，攻击会立刻触发，
并使命中的敌人进入30秒的防御力下降状态。

<color=blue>抓住敌人攻击的时机释放该技能吧！

菲约尔姆拥有强大的生存能力。
她的“背水奋战”能力可使她在HP越少的情况下减伤幅度越高。
且HP不足一半时，能够在任务中永久提升攻击力和防御力。

<color=red>不过注意，每次玩家重生时，该效果会被解除！</color>

The standard attack of a close-range-manacaster deals damage to enemies in a line,
and move backward a certain distance.

Press the directional key <color=blue>{0}/{1}</color> during the attack to change the attack direction.

Eirene has a special 'Armament Gauge' that automatically charges over time (up to 2).

When using Skill 1 and Skill 2, Eirene consumes one charge of the Armament Gauge.

Eirene gains the 'Overclock' buff after using her Skill 2.
During the buff, the Armament Gauge charges faster,
and standard attacks are enhanced, dealing more damage.

<color=red>Try to keep the Overclock buff active as long as possible!</color>

When Eirene uses Skill 1, press the directional key <color=blue>{0}/{1}</color> to adjust the attack position.

Additionally, after using Skill 3, the next Skill 1 used will deal more damage to enemies in <color=red>break state</color>,
but her strength will be reduced after a few seconds.

Sarisse's 'Brilliant Bolt' deals damage to enemies directly ahead,
and fires extra shots equal to the number of buffs she has.

Every 20 combo count, Sarisse increases her strength, critical raate and energy level.
<color=red>Try to keep the combo count!</color>

Sarisse's 'Cheerful Assist' can fills the skill gauge for 'Brilliant Bolt' by 100%.

If used again, the skill will additionally increase defense and max HP.

<color=red>Having strength/defense buffs will also give Sarisse additional
attack speed and skill damage buffs.</color>

Sanzaka's 'Dancing Blossom' deals damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Bleeding.

After using 'Blooming Cradle', Sanzaka gains a buff that makes her immune to knockback in addition.

Sanzaka's 'Blooming Cradle' increases her strength and max HP,
and grants her 'Slumber Strike Stance', making her next three force strikes deal more damage, inflict sleep and dispel one buff from each target.

Laxi is a special dagger unit capable of ranged attacks.
Laxi's combo has a standard and a delayed version.
High-performance delayed version will be applied if the player waits for about 0.5 seconds after each combo before pressing attack again.

Laxi has a charge gauge with three bars.
The charge gauge fills when standard attacks, force strikes, and dash attacks hit enemys. And grants cumulative buffs to Laxi based on the number of bars filled.
<color=red>Note that her delayed version standard combo can fill more charge gauge.</color>

Press <color=red>{8}</color> to enter Eden Mode when the charge gauge has at least one bar.
This summons "Fig" that automatically attacks nearby targets, and all skills will be enhanced.

<color=blue>Note: The charge gauge will not fill during Eden Mode and will empty after exiting!
It's better to activate it when fully charged!</color>

Laxi’s first skill deals damage can apply the <color=blue>Resonance Imprint</color> debuff to targets,
and significantly fills the charge gauge.
(<color=red>In Eden Mode, it fills all attack skill gauges instead</color>).
Enemies with Resonance Mark have reduced resistance to burn and scorchrend.
When the debuff is removed, affected target will take stack-based damage!

In Eden Mode, Laxi’s second skill dispels <color=red>all Resonance Imprint</color>
from targets and dealing damage to surrounding enemies!

Hold directional keys {0}/{1} before attacking to adjust move direction.

<color=red>Laxi’s third skill varies based on player input.</color>
Hold forward (facing direction) after activating the skill to dash forward;
Hold backward (opposite facing direction) after activation to move backward;
<color=blue>In Eden Mode, attacks dispel one enemy buffs
and grant a buff that gradually fill Laxi's skill gauges.</color>
